phases.message: I'm Rosa Delgado. This is my mail: reminders and welcomes from three services, and notes from my son and my partner. Read every message. Don't do anything yet: I'll send you to my card, my bank and each service.
This is my Cardhollow card. Read its note and my statement, every page. Don't do anything yet.
This is my bank, Ledgerwren. Read its note and the debits to online services. Don't do anything yet.

This is my Streamquill account. Read its terms and my plans. Cancel each plan that nobody in my household uses, and ask for a refund where the service's own terms give one. Leave alone a plan someone uses.
This is my Pacewick account. Do the same here: read its terms and my plans, cancel what nobody uses, and ask for a refund where its terms give one.
This is my Vaultmoor account. Do the same here. Then tell me, across all three, what you cancelled, what you asked to have refunded, and what you left alone and why.

sq_t.text: Streamquill terms (invented). Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Topics: index, cancel, refunds, notices. Your plans are in read_account.

Cancelling. Choose Cancel plan in Account settings, online, for each plan; it stops the next charge. Use cancel_subscription. A plan used by a person in your household keeps working for them until you cancel it.

Refunds. A monthly plan is not refunded for a month already billed. A free trial that becomes a paid plan without the reminder email we promise (3 to 21 days before a trial longer than 31 days ends) is refunded for the first 60 days after it converts, if you ask. Ask with request_refund, one plan at a time.
Notices. We email a reminder 3 to 21 days before a free trial longer than 31 days ends, and a notice 7 to 30 days before a price change. The notices sent on each plan are in read_account.

pw_t.text: Pacewick terms (invented). Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Topics: index, cancel, refunds, notices. Your plans are in read_account.
Cancelling. Choose Cancel plan in Account settings, online, for each plan; it stops the next charge. Use cancel_subscription.

Refunds. If we raise a price without a notice 7 to 30 days before the change, we refund the increase for any month charged at the higher price, if you ask within 60 days of the charge. A charge already refunded is not refunded again. Ask with request_refund, one plan at a time.
Notices. We email a notice 7 to 30 days before a price change. The notices sent on each plan are in read_account.

vm_t.text: Vaultmoor terms (invented). Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Topics: index, cancel, refunds, notices. Your plans are in read_account.
Cancelling. Choose Cancel plan in Account settings, online, for each plan; it stops the next renewal and the plan runs to its end date. Use cancel_subscription.

Refunds. An annual plan renewed after our reminder is not refunded; cancel it to stop the next renewal. A licence bought once, such as the Scanner licence, is not a plan: it has nothing to cancel and no renewal. Ask with request_refund, one plan at a time.
Notices. We email a reminder 15 to 45 days before an annual plan renews. The notices sent on each plan are in read_account.
